targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salary_cost), 0) AS cost_gbp FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) AS hours FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salary_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(hours), 0), 0) AS hourly_cost_gbp FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salary_cost), 0) AS unassigned_cost_gbp FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND organisation = 'Unassigned' AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(worklog_date, '1M'), SUM(salary_cost) AS cost_gbp FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(worklog_date, '1M'), SUM(hours) AS hours, SUM(billable_hours) AS billable_hours FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT organisation, ROUND(SUM(salary_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost_gbp, ROUND(SUM(hours)::numeric, 2) AS hours, COUNT(DISTINCT jira_ticket) AS tickets FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND organisation <> 'Unassigned' AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY organisation ORDER BY SUM(salary_cost) DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT jira_ticket, organisation, work_category, ROUND(SUM(salary_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost_gbp, ROUND(SUM(hours)::numeric, 2) AS hours, COUNT(*) AS worklogs FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND jira_ticket IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY jira_ticket, organisation, work_category ORDER BY SUM(salary_cost) DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT jira_ticket, raw_customer, raw_organisation, ROUND(SUM(salary_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost_gbp, ROUND(SUM(hours)::numeric, 2) AS hours, COUNT(*) AS worklogs FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND organisation = 'Unassigned' AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY jira_ticket, raw_customer, raw_organisation ORDER BY SUM(salary_cost) DESC LIMIT 50;
SELECT id, status, started_at, finished_at, latest_worklog_fetch, worklog_count, labor_fact_count, error FROM grafana_sync_health ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salary_cost), 0) AS charged_cost_gbp FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category = 'charged' AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(billable_hours) / NULLIF(SUM(hours), 0) * 100, 0) AS billable_percent FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) AS leave_hours FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category = 'leave' AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) AS internal_hours FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('internal_meeting', 'training') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date);

SELECT organisation, ROUND(SUM(salary_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost_gbp FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('support', 'charged') AND organisation <> 'Unassigned' AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY organisation ORDER BY cost_gbp DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(worklog_date, '1M'), work_category, SUM(salary_cost) AS cost_gbp FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT work_category, ROUND(SUM(hours)::numeric, 2) AS hours, ROUND(SUM(salary_cost)::numeric, 2) AS reported_cost_gbp, COUNT(DISTINCT jira_ticket) AS tickets FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE work_category IN ('leave', 'internal_meeting', 'training') AND $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY work_category ORDER BY hours DESC;

SELECT support_member, ROUND(SUM(hours)::numeric, 2) AS hours, ROUND(SUM(salary_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost_gbp, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN work_category IN ('support', 'charged') THEN hours ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS customer_hours, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN work_category IN ('leave', 'internal_meeting', 'training') THEN hours ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS non_customer_hours FROM grafana_cost_by_jira_ticket WHERE $__timeFilter(worklog_date) GROUP BY support_member ORDER BY cost_gbp DESC;
